time_of_row: t = row / 60 seconds of song time (analysis windows are centred on t; n_fft 2048, hop 735)
normalisation: per channel: (x - p1) / (p99 - p1) over non-silent rows (mix peak > -60 dBFS); rms_drums/bass/vocals/other use only rows where that stem is above -50 dBFS, so a silent stem reads 0

units_before_normalisation.rms*: dBFS of frame RMS (mix and each demucs stem)
units_before_normalisation.onset: librosa onset strength of the 128-band log-mel mix (spectral flux)
units_before_normalisation.onset_drums: librosa onset strength of the drums stem
units_before_normalisation.centroid: log2(spectral centroid Hz + 1) of the mix
units_before_normalisation.flux: L2 norm of the positive change of the L1-normalised magnitude spectrum
units_before_normalisation.mel_00..mel_15: dB of 16 mel bands 30 Hz - 16 kHz of the mix (00 = lowest)
